ability.name: Step 2 — Verify Nmap Availability
ability.description: Establish whether the binary 'nmap' is locally accessible to drive faster stealth scanner execution pathing.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $nmapPath = Get-Command nmap -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($nmapPath) { $v = nmap --version 2>&1 | Out-String; Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true"; Write-Output "NMAP_VERSION: $v" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false"; Write-Output "ERROR: step2_nmap_check $($_.Exception.Message)" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/nmap_check.txt

rationale: Verify Nmap presence dynamically to switch execution paths.
